summary.name: ShanShenBu AI Dance
summary.one_liner: A web tool that turns one full-body photo of a person or pet into a ~13–15 second vertical AI flash-step (闪身步) dance video with sound.
use_cases: Make a short AI dance video of yourself from one photo
Create a flash-step dance clip of a pet for social posts
Produce vertical 9:16 clips for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
Try the viral flash-step trend without learning the dance
One-off purchase instead of a monthly video subscription
summary.what_it_does: The site takes one clear full-body photo (a person standing facing the camera, or a pet with its face visible) and generates a roughly 13–15 second 9:16 MP4 with sound. The routine is fixed: flash step, ball kick, shiver, and head wobble. Human mode keeps the person's face, hair and clothes in a scene (about 13 seconds); pet mode places the animal in a sunny courtyard, upright on its hind legs (about 15 seconds). Credit packs are sold as one-time purchases starting at $8.88 for one 720p render, with no app install or subscription. The page also offers template previews such as a vault world-swap and a skirt-ad text clip, which it describes as separate from the flash-step style.
notable: Fixed four-move flash-step routine from one photo, human or pet
Pay-once credit packs from $8.88, no subscription or app
Outputs vertical 9:16 MP4 with sound and no watermark, per the page
Pet mode places animal in a courtyard scene
